whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sujata Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has over 2,000 reviews on Fraser Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated online table reservation and digital menu experience.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special biryani & tandoori menu showcase, aur interactive gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://sujatarestaurant.shop/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sujata Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first menu display for Fraser Road diners. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
